subject: Production ingestion pipeline throwing 502 Bad Gateway on POST /v1/events
body:
Hi Support Team,

Our production ingestion pipeline is throwing 502 Bad Gateway errors on POST /v1/events since 09:00 UTC.

Trace ID: tr_8f902a1b
SDK: mermail-python-v2.1.0
Environment: Production

All real-time streaming batches are failing with no available workaround. We need on-call assistance ASAP.

Thanks,
Sarah Jenkins
